description: CYBEX is developing an electrochemical process to recover critical raw materials from end-of-life solar modules, aiming to make recycling more efficient and economically viable.
funding_summary: Received an ERC Proof of Concept Grant of €150,000 in June 2026.
inflection_why_now: The increasing accumulation of end-of-life solar modules presents a pressing need for efficient recycling solutions to recover valuable materials and support sustainable practices in the renewable energy sector.
devils_advocate_risks: Technological Feasibility: Ensuring the electrochemical process can be scaled effectively for industrial applications.
Market Adoption: Convincing existing recycling facilities to adopt new, unproven technologies.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in specialty chemicals and materials, aligning with CYBEX's focus on extracting valuable metals from waste streams.
WACKER is involved in chemical production and materials science, which could complement CYBEX's recycling technology development.
